description: Turns labeled with the recipe category a dispatch would draw from, for the turn site's category-first recipe pick. Asked as the turn site with the catalog forced over the option limit by recipeOptionLimit, so the category question is what the engine answers. /none is the option for no fitting category. Categories and purposes follow AGENT_CATEGORY_PURPOSE in src/domains/agents/spec.ts and each recipe's own category where it declares one. Split: a case with no split field or split fit is in the fit split; split holdout was written before any score on it was seen and is scored once against cuts chosen on fit. New cases alternate fit and holdout within each authored class.
